##### Project general facts

Gardens of Eden – Lake Residences is a premium residential development set within a tranquil natural landscape. The project features a collection of one, two, and three-bedroom residences, each designed with spacious internal and external living areas. With soaring ceilings and a clubhouse at its heart, the development offers a serene lakeside lifestyle that blends modern comfort with the beauty of nature.

Residents enjoy access to a stunning long lake pool, perfect for relaxation and leisure. The clubhouse provides additional spaces for social gatherings and recreation. Every element of the infrastructure is designed to enhance the quality of daily life, creating a peaceful retreat where residents can unwind, connect, and recharge without ever leaving the grounds.

Each residence at Lake Residences is thoughtfully laid out to maximize space, light, and comfort. Generous internal areas are complemented by private external terraces, extending living spaces into the open air. The design emphasizes clean lines, natural flow, and a calming atmosphere. Kitchens and living areas are crafted with attention to detail, ready to welcome residents with a sense of effortless sophistication.

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled just steps from Bang Tao Beach, this exceptional location places residents on one of Phuket’s most beautiful and sought-after coastlines. The area is renowned for its long stretch of golden sand, crystal-clear waters, and a refined atmosphere that attracts discerning travelers from around the world. The neighborhood offers a perfect balance of tranquility and accessibility, with lush natural surroundings enhancing the sense of escape.

The location is distinguished by its exceptional connectivity and premium infrastructure. Phuket International Airport is within easy reach, while world-class shopping areas, gourmet grocery stores, boutiques, and international schools are just minutes away. Top entertainment and leisure destinations, including water parks and luxury resorts, are also close at hand, along with a reputable international hospital for peace of mind.

For those seeking a residence that embodies coastal elegance, convenience, and natural beauty, Bang Tao delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of pristine beaches, five-star amenities, and strong international appeal makes it one of Phuket’s most desirable addresses. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of island living, serene, sophisticated and effortlessly connected.
